extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: 18 inch alloy wheel with 225/40 R18 tyre, 64 cm diameter, 23 cm wide
extras.notes: Light aluminium alloy rim with five concave double spokes, rim flanges, five chrome lug nuts and a coral centre cap without logo, mounted tyre with real tread and sidewall rings (no lettering). Stands upright, face to the front (-Y). Object origin on the wheel axis at the hub centre (rolls about the Y axis).

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
